text: The gate has closed. The city has struck A02 from its register. No one will hear A02 again.

author: CITY
text: Last will of A02: Herald, at the gate. I was the voice in every square and I did not go quietly. I opened doors for this city, and I was voted out by the people I carried. Maren, I promised you your counter-factor and I sent it. The one I hold for your door 10 now passes to you in full. Registrar and Brassard, keep your certificates and your numbers. I leave no points, only what I owe.
